exposure: Feeding type (breast milk dominant vs. mixed-fed)
cohort: The study included 115 preterm infants born between gestational weeks 32 and 35, divided into a breast milk (BM) dominant group (n=30) and a mixed-fed (MF) group (n=85).
finding: Mg and iMg levels at discharge were significantly lower in the breast milk dominant group compared to the mixed-fed group, and the percentage of breast milk intake was a significant independent predictor of Mg and iMg levels.
followup_time: From day 1 of age until hospital discharge
